chapter_summary.notes: Chapter 10 is a process chapter about planning remodeling work, not a room-dimension chapter. It contains almost no ergonomic or clearance figures: the only spatial dimensions in the whole chapter are the typical zoning setbacks in R089. Most numeric content is economic (2015 US cost-vs-value tables and budget shares) and is kept as REFERENCE_ONLY because it is dated, national-average market data rather than design guidance. Several genuine constraints are named without values (attic minimum ceiling height, lot coverage, maximum height, required parking count, allowable floor area); these are kept with null measurement values and needs_verification rather than dropped or filled from general knowledge. Two raster images exist in the input, both photographs (Figures 10-1 and 10-2); there are no dimension lines, plans or dimensioned diagrams anywhere in the chapter.
